plugins.name: open-claude
plugins.description: Discord channel for Claude Code — talk to Claude from Discord with auto-reply hooks, independent thread sessions, typing indicators, access control, and cron job support.

plugins.name: isol-bridge
plugins.description: Multi-session bridge for Claude Code — window/mirror/meta sessions communicate via file-based inbox messages. Window's turn auto-broadcasts via Stop hook; other sessions push actively via helper script.
